data.narrative:
Cuby Technologies is a Series B-stage housing and construction company founded by Aleks Gampel and Aleh Kandrashou. The company has raised $23.4M to date. The comp universe consists of four private-stage peers in adjacent housing and construction verticals—Plantd Materials, Cover, Somos, and Charge Robotics—with no directly comparable public companies identified.

A stage-progression valuation method was applied, using the $23.4M total capital raised as a value proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to later-stage progressions. This approach yielded an implied valuation of $44M. Given the single-method constraint and inherent variability in stage-based multiples, a range of $38M to $51M was derived, anchored at a median of $44M.

The analysis is limited by the absence of public comparables and reliance on a single methodological pillar. A more robust valuation would benefit from revenue or EBITDA multiples drawn from the private comp set, as well as consideration of market-specific capital intensity and development timelines typical to housing technology. Key uncertainties include burn rate trajectory, path to profitability, and relative competitive positioning within the comp peer group. The $44M median should be treated as directional pending disclosure of Cuby's unit economics and near-term financing strategy.
